spans.s: --a kingdom that took its name after कुशल, son of Dyutimat. Also कुशल, adjoining क्रौञ्च hill in क्रौञ्चद्वीप. Br. II. १४. २४; १९. ७१.
--seven in number, and contemporaries of seven आन्ध्रस्, and lords of विदूर; then निषधस्. भा.
(I)--a wife of Vasudeva and mother of केशिन्--see भद्रा। भा. IX. २४. ४८.
(II)--a queen of दशरथ and mother of राम. Br. III. ३७. ३१; IV. ४०. ११२.
(III)--a queen of सात्वत; mother of Bhaja- मान and others; four branches of the line from them are important. M. ४४. ४७. वा. ९
--the capital of Nemicakra (Nicakru-व्। प्।) after Hastinapura was washed by floods; of विविक्षु. भा. IX. २२. ४०; वा. ९९. २७१; Vi. IV. २१. 8. M. ५०. ७९.
(I)--a sage who called on dying भीष्म. भा.

(II)--practised वर्म नारायणात्मकम् and gave up his body. When Citraratha, the Gandharva crossed on his bones, he fell down to the earth, and on वालखिल्यस्’ suggestion, he gathered them and throwing into the Saras- वती, went away to his home. भा.
(IV)--a name of विश्वामित्र (गाधि-वि। प्।) helped the banished Satyavrata to get a place among the planets out of gratitude for his having helped गालव during the १२ year famine.
(V)--a नाग residing in Tatvalam. Br. II. २०. १९.

(VII)--a son of Vasudeva and सैव्या (वैशालि- वि। प्।) adopted by his brother वृक,
1: Br. III. ७१. १७४-5; १९३; वा. ९६. १८२; Vi. IV. १५. २५.
born of a वैश्य wife.
2: M. ४६. २०.

(VIII)--a sage by tapas of the epoch of सावर्णि;
1:

. ३२; १४५. ९३.
a sage of कुरुक्षेत्र who had seven sons who, during famine, had their guru's cow killed and after offer- ing it for श्राद्ध, made a meal themselves; but after five rebirths they attained final beatitude. These five rebirths detailed.
2: Ib. १९. १२; Ch. २०.
(IX)--a son of Vidarbha and father of चिदी. वा. ९५. ३६, ३८.
--the wife of Suhotra and mother of Janhu. वा. ९१. ५४. [page१-475+ २८]

--got different pravaras from the विस्वा- mitras;
1: भा. IX. १६. ३७.
about २५ among them mentioned: पार्थिवस्, Deva- rathas, याज्ञवल्क्यस्, समर्षणस्, Udumbaras, उदुम्लानस्, तारकस्, यममुञ्चतस्, लोहिण्यस्, रेणवस्, काञ्षवस्, Babhravas, पाणिनस्, ध्यानजप्यस्, शालावक्यस्, हिरण्- याक्षस्, स्यङ्कृतस्, गालवस्, Devalas, यामदूतस्, सालङ्का- यनबाषकलस्, ददातिबादरस्, etc.; marriage alliances only with other ऋषि gotras allowed.
2: वा. ९१. ९७-102.

. ३५५; ६६. ५९; वा. ९१. ८८.
sacred to पितृस्; one of the wives of हव्यवाहन fire.
3: M. २२. ६३; ५१. १४; वा. २९. १४.
--a sacred place for श्राद्ध offerings. Br. III. १३. १०९.
(II)--a son of जटमालि of the १९थ् द्वापर। वा. २३. १८७.
--the collective name of the sons of काक्- षीवत्. M. ४८. ८८.

; XI. १४. ४०; २७. २७; XII. ११. १०.
the festival that came out of the churning of the milk ocean.
2: Br.
